text: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: ko onon yo heddiiɓe e Alyahuudaaku ɓaawo wayleede ɗum ! Si on aaƴike wonnde ko on yiɗaaɓe Allah heertiniraaɓe ɗum ko wanaa yimɓe hedditiiɓe ɓen, haray yelee maayde fii no O yaccinirana on ko O heertinani on kon e teddungal ngal aaƴiɗon, si tawii ko on goonguɓe e kon ko nodditorɗon.
